item.title: Joseph Tomtishen Named North Schuylkill Head Football Coach for 2026 Season
item.description: The North Schuylkill Board of Education officially approved the hiring of Joseph Tomtishen as the Spartans’ new Head Football Coach during its monthly meeting Wednesday night. Tomtishen will take over the program beginning with the 2026 season, replacing longtime head coach Wally Hall, who resigned in December after 13 seasons leading the Spartans.
